From:            Justin Poole
To:              ext_Dennis_Moore; ext_Christian_Williams
Cc:              Ilka Berrios; Brent Ballard
Subject:         Crane Clean Energy Center – Fixed Fee Caps for Ongoing Licensing Actions
Date:            Tuesday, September 29, 2026 8:47:44 AM



Dennis,

In accordance with 10 CFR 170.33, which becomes effective on October 1, 2026, this communication
establishes the fixed cap on service fees (fixed fee cap) for the Constellation Energy Generation, LLC
(CEG) licensing actions for the Christopher M. Crane Clean Energy Center listed in the table below.
The table lists the fixed fee caps for the NRC’s review of ongoing licensing actions that have been
accepted for review that will be within the scope of 10 CFR 170.33. Fixed fee caps for other licensing
actions, such as those currently under acceptance review, will be communicated by separate
correspondence. The NRC considered various factors when establishing these fixed fee caps, such as
the quality and complexity of the application, technology type, and any pre-application engagement.
The Professional Hourly Rate established at 10 CFR 170.20(a) applies to these licensing actions.

Application Date     Acceptance            EPID                                             Fixed Fee
(ADAMS               Date                                                                   Cap
Accession No.)
 11/19/2024           12/20/2024            L-2024-LLE-0031, TMI-1/Crane Exemption to    $121,000.00
(ML24324A048)                              50.82(a)(2) to Support Restart
7/31/2025            9/4/2025              L-2025-LLA-0123, License Amendment to         $263,000.00
(ML25212A076)                              Restore Operating License and Technical
                                           Specifications
 10/24/2025           12/2/2025             L-2025-LLA-0161, LAR to Revise Security Plan $132,000.00
(ML25300A118)                              to Support Restart
 10/31/2025           12/9/2025             L-2025-LLA-0162, License Amendment to        $189,000.00
(ML25304A097)                              Restore Emergency Plan to Support Potential
                                           Restart

The fixed fee cap represents the maximum amount that the NRC may charge for service fees for each
of the requested licensing actions following acceptance of the complete application. The fixed fee cap
will not be increased except in instances of applicant failure, as defined in 10 CFR 170.3. If applicant
failure occurs, the NRC will notify CEG in writing of the new fixed fee cap, which will be set at the
lowest practicable amount determined by the NRC to account for the applicant failure and complete
the review.

For each licensing action, the NRC will track service fees against the fixed fee cap beginning on the
acceptance date listed above.  

Disputes associated with a fixed fee cap must be submitted in accordance with 10 CFR 15.31 and
170.33(f) and NRC Form 529 procedures. If you have any questions, please contact me.
 Justin C. Poole
